case: Shadowed-search_path enum metadata and consumer behavior through 256 nested domains
contract: The native contract checks domain-over-enum chains at depths 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 63, 64, 65, 128, 129 and 256 while search_path resolves a same-named shadow enum.

At every tested depth, recursive catalog metadata resolves the target enum leaf; schema-aware keyed updates, label and SQL NULL draft inserts, typed equality filters, and exact outer-domain/native value checks succeed.
At depths through 63, raw inferred SQL NULL updates succeed with the outer domain type preserved, and an invalid raw text label is refused by PostgreSQL with SQLSTATE 22P02.
At depths 64 and above, raw inferred SQL NULL and both valid and invalid text are refused as Unsupported, including after schema-aware operations have warmed the same-backend transaction.
Same-backend search_path changes and rollback checks preserve exact native values and types at every tested depth.

native_contract_group.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration domain_contract:: -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1
